topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct; POL-05 acknowledgment at hire and yearly; security sanctions in POL-01 4.8
evidence: Code of conduct; 2024 policy acknowledgments (97%); sanctions log (4 in 2025-2026)

control_description: Board audit committee (independent chair) receives quarterly cyber risk, POA&M, and SOC 2 readiness reports from the vCISO
gap: Cyber reporting became quarterly only in 2026; SOC 2 scope not yet reviewed by the committee
remediation: Committee approves the SOC 2 scope and receives readiness reports each quarter through the observation period

control_description: Roles and authority set in POL-01 and the SSP; vCISO, IT Director (ISO), Security Manager, OT Security Engineer, and platform owners named
Background checks; job descriptions with security duties; role-based training for IT and CUI roles
gap: No role-based OT security or privacy training for 80 Building Technology and ROC staff

control_description: Risk owners named for every risk; sanctions; performance goals for control owners include POA&M milestones
evidence: Risk register owners; 2026 goals for platform owners

control_description: Inventories, logs, and metrics support control operation
evidence: IT inventories; SIEM; monthly metrics pack
gap: OT inventory not reconciled at 40 sites; OT events not collected

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies published on the intranet; annual training; ROC reporting line
gap: 5 of 15 interviewed staff did not know the reporting line; new policy acknowledgments due 2026-11-30
remediation: Wallet cards, toolbox talks, and acknowledgments

control_description: Customer contracts, notification matrix, and customer security contacts; vulnerability disclosure contact on the website
gap: No interconnection agreements with 4 customers; no customer-facing system description; subcontractor notice terms missing for SUB-4 to SUB-7
remediation: Interconnection agreements (POAM-018); system description draft; subcontractor addendum (POAM-013)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives set in the BIA, risk appetite statements, and customer contract terms
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment covering OT, subcontractors, and supply chain
Fraud scenarios considered in the risk assessment (payment redirection, insider sabotage)
gap: No documented fraud risk assessment by finance; dual approval for bank changes not yet live
remediation: Finance fraud risk review; dual approval for bank detail changes

control_description: Changes to contracts and systems trigger risk review
gap: No security due diligence checklist for acquisitions; OT changes lack impact analysis
remediation: Acquisition checklist (R-048); OT impact questions in the CMMS (CM-4)

control_description: Annual independent assessment by the co-sourced internal audit firm with an OT specialist; monthly metrics
Deficiencies tracked in the POA&M with owners and dates; reported quarterly to the audit committee
evidence: P07 poam.csv (23 items); audit committee minutes

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53 Moderate baseline and tailored for OT, mapped to risks
General IT controls for identity, cloud, endpoints, and change management
gap: General controls over OT technology (baselines, change approval, privileged roles) not yet in place

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies POL-01 to POL-05 approved; standards index
gap: 6 of 10 standards in draft
remediation: Issue standards on the P06 schedule (POAM-023)

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Identity provider with MFA; broker for OT remote access; tenant and cluster role models
gap: Subcontractor remote access outside the broker at 11 sites; shared accounts on 3 clusters and one tenant

control_description: Accounts created from HR and approved tickets in the identity provider; tenant and cluster accounts from CMMS tickets
gap: Tenant and cluster registration is manual and not reconciled to the identity provider

control_description: Role-based access; reviews; removal at termination and transfer
gap: 6 of 25 terminations late in customer tenants; semiannual OT reviews; excess privilege on 3 clusters

control_description: Badge-controlled offices and ROC zones; visitor logs; panel keys
evidence: Badge reports; visitor logs; P07 PE-3
gap: 64 panel keys without a log or inventory

control_description: Media sanitization and disposal under NIST SP 800-88 with certificates
gap: OT drives and controllers returned to customers without wiping

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Hub firewall, edge firewalls, deny-by-default at segmented sites, external scans
gap: 17 flat sites; cellular modem bypass; 14 edge firewalls behind on firmware

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS and IPsec in transit; CUI library secure links
gap: CUI sent by email outside the library (3 of 20 sampled)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on laptops, ROC workstations, and cloud servers; application control on ROC workstations
gap: No malware protection on 9 unsupported engineering workstations

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Monthly IT scans; posture service for cloud; configuration baselines for IT
gap: No OT vulnerability identification or OT configuration baselines; inventory gaps

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: 24x7 MDR for IT sources; passive OT sensors at 12 sites
gap: OT, tenant, and cluster events not monitored

control_description: MSSP triage and escalation within 30 minutes; incident log
evidence: Escalation records; incident log (10 of 37 sampled)
gap: 3 OT events in 2026 were handled outside the incident log

control_description: POL-03 and two P08 runbooks; notification matrix
gap: Runbooks untested; plan not distributed to customers

control_description: Isolated write-once backups; rebuild runbooks; manual-mode procedures at federal and state sites
evidence: Backup reports; restore records; exercise reports
gap: Observed cluster restore missed its RTO; no manual-mode procedures for 4 customers

control_description: CAB for IT and cloud; CMMS change tickets for BAS programs and door schedules
gap: 9 of 25 BAS program changes without approval; no integrity check

control_description: BIA, cyber insurance, backup ROC, and manual-mode procedures
gap: No IFOP contingency plan yet

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Tier 1 vendor SOC 2 reviews (Part B); subcontractor security addendum
gap: 4 of 7 OT subcontractors not bound or reviewed; face verification and video analytics modules outside the vendor SOC 2 scope

control_description: Cloud capacity monitored by the posture service; ROC staffing model; SIEM capacity
Isolated, encrypted, write-once backups in a second region; dual ISPs at both ROCs; generator at HQ
evidence: Backup job reports (30 of 30 days); vault settings
gap: Controller program repository covers about 55% of controllers; single circuits at 34 sites
remediation: POAM-020; cellular backup at critical County B and City buildings

control_description: Restore tests and exercises
evidence: CT-S cluster restore (11 hours); County B restore (14 hours); ROC drill (2 hours 40 minutes)
gap: Recovery tests miss RTOs or have not been run for 7 clusters
remediation: Quarterly restore tests; semiannual ROC drill (POAM-010)

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Classification in POL-04; CUI library; data location register; encryption
gap: Subcontractor copies not in the register; CUI copies in mailboxes

control_description: Disposal under POL-04 and Fla. Stat. 501.171(8); template deletion rules
gap: OT media returned unwiped; end-of-contract retention defined for CT-S only; face template retention was indefinite until 2026-10-31
remediation: Disposal procedure; retention terms per customer; P10 conditions
